reviewNote: This is the single consolidated IG1 + IG2 ABI review required by the B34 acceptance criteria. It is a binding layer, not a re-pinning: F02 owns the 132-row format registry, the HeaderV1 gate owns the three-way HeaderV1 contract, sdk-abi-fixtures owns the 86 golden encodings and F20 owns the coverage reconciliation, and this artifact binds those surfaces by number instead of copying their contents. Everything published here is re-derived from source by demo/scripts/verify-canonical-v1-abi-freeze.mjs; nothing in this file is its own authority. IG1's structural half is closed: the seven deployment-ABI identities agree across midgard-core, midgard-node and midgard-sdk, the frozen catalogue order is a bijection onto the validator tree, and the blueprint comes from the compiler aiken.toml declares. Two observations are recorded rather than hidden. ABI-04 carries declarationOrder DIVERGENT: midgard-core and midgard-sdk declare the same 38-role token mapping in different key orders. That is not an ABI break because every consumer reads the map by key and midgard-node compares it with requireExactKeys, but it is measured and published so the divergence cannot grow into one unseen. IG2 is BLOCKED: 11 families are registered in the frozen catalogue while none of them carries valid-block rejection, maximum proof-fit or correction evidence, so under GOAL_SPEC 11 IG2 none of them may be integrated on this evidence.
